result.brief: 提出 ComCLIP：冻结文本编码器、以合适温度对比损失结合 MSE 锚定与 DINOv2 关系蒸馏，改进 CLIP 视觉编码器特征迁移性。
result.reason: Contributes a CLIP vision-encoder post-training recipe improving transferable visual features via contrastive loss, MSE anchoring, and DINOv2 relational distillation—directly a visual representation learning contribution.
